# QR tool dependencies

These fixed versions are served locally so QR generation does not require a CDN connection.

- qrcode-generator 1.4.4, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT. Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.min.js
- encoding-japanese 2.2.0, polygonplanet, MIT. Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/encoding-japanese@2.2.0/encoding.min.js

License texts are included next to the JavaScript files. The QR tools use Byte mode for both UTF-8 and Shift_JIS.
